mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 9.5% in the latest month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 95.0 signals manufacturing contraction that intensifies supply chain disruptions and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO remains below 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals robust demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 2.5%) signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 93.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO remains below 93.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
